title: Female AEW Wrestler Gets Her Shirt Ripped Off On Dynamite (WATCH) - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Clark ,
43 minutes ago
This week’s episode of AEW Dynamite featured a chaotic backstage moment when Mina Shirakawa ripped open Harley Cameron’s shirt during a pre-match pep talk.
The segment took place during a backstage interview with Renee Paquette, as Shirakawa attempted to fire up Cameron ahead of their tag team match against Hikaru Shida and Kris Statlander.
Trying to motivate her partner, Shirakawa told Cameron to stop focusing on outside distractions and concentrate on winning the match. She said,
“Harley, wake up! What Shida has done to Stat and us is not good. Can you trust Stat? I hope so. But tonight, beyond friends, beyond how you feel, we have a match to win!”
She then reminded Cameron of her accomplishments in AEW. She stated,

“Harley, you are one of the first ever tag team champions. So stop looking out there! Look it in here!”
As she delivered the line, Shirakawa dramatically ripped Cameron’s shirt open to hype her up. However, she quickly realized that Cameron was not already wearing her wrestling gear underneath. A shocked Shirakawa immediately apologized. She said,
“Oh no, I’m sorry! I thought you had your gear on!”
Cameron stayed fully in character despite the mishap. She said,
“I’m not. But I don’t care! Shida, Stat, the wrath is back tonight, and you’re gonna feel it!”
Later in the night, Statlander used her power advantage early against Shirakawa, while Cameron showcased her athleticism once she entered the bout.
Shida and Shirakawa exchanged heavy strikes before Cameron received the hot tag and nearly secured a major win for her team. At one point, Shirakawa and Cameron appeared close to victory following a double-team sequence, but Shida managed to break up the pin attempt at the last second.
The finish turned chaotic after Statlander was accidentally struck by a misplaced knee. Cameron continued fighting back with a neckbreaker and roundhouse kick combination, but the numbers game eventually caught up to her.
In the end, Shida connected with a Falcon Arrow on Cameron while Statlander prevented any interference, securing the win for their team.
